Cloud Software Engineer Intern

Your Role

As a Cloud Software Engineering Intern, you will support the development of software solutions that operate in Linux-based and cloud environments. You will work closely with experienced engineers while gaining hands-on experience in software development, cloud technologies, and modern engineering practices.

Responsibilities



-  Support the design, development, testing, and maintenance of software applications and tools.
-  Develop and enhance software components using C and/or Python.
-  Work with Linux-based systems for development, debugging, and testing activities.
-  Collaborate with engineering teams to troubleshoot technical issues and improve software quality.
-  Contribute to projects related to cloud infrastructure and cloud-native technologies when applicable.
-  Participate in code reviews, team discussions, and knowledge-sharing sessions.
-  Document technical work and provide regular project updates.

Your Background



- Currently pursuing a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
- Experience with software development projects through coursework, personal projects, research, internships, or extracurricular activities.
- Knowledge of programming in C and/or Python.
- Familiarity with Linux operating systems.
- Exposure to cloud infrastructure or cloud technologies is a plus but not required.
- Previous internship experience is preferred but not required.
- Strong problem-solving, communication, and teamwork skills.

Why Join Aptiv / Wind River

You grow at Aptiv.

Aptiv's winning culture is global by design. We bring together diverse perspectives, cultures, and business contexts to solve our customers' toughest challenges. In this environment, every individual can grow, lead, and make an impact, regardless of background, because inclusion fuels how we innovate and win.

You make an impact at Aptiv.

One of the strengths of humanity is our drive to progress, to improve, to achieve more tomorrow than we did yesterday. People need solutions they can trust when it matters most. At Aptiv, you are building those solutions every day.

You have support at Aptiv.

We ensure you have the resources and support you need to take care of your family, your physical health, and your mental health with a competitive benefits package.

Your Benefits



- Working in an international company that takes pride in a mission and vision, to make the world a safer, greener and better connected place
- Opportunities to join social events, including sport groups and celebrations 
- Holiday Pay
- Learning and development opportunities
- Discount programs with various manufacturers and retailers
- Recognition for innovation and excellence
- Opportunities to give back to the community

Compensation

This role is compensation range is between $4,000 to $5,000 Compensation is determined through interviews and a review of the education, experience, knowledge, skills, location, and abilities of the applicant, and equity with other team members.

Meet the Next-Generation Aptiv / Wind River

At Wind River, we deliver innovative solutions that people trust when it matters most.

Progress is never static. It is about reaching further, exploring new possibilities, and enabling mobility. Wind River empowers customers to create solutions people rely on, advancing safety and autonomy in Automotive and Commercial Vehicles, enabling mission-critical performance in Aerospace & Defense, and powering intelligent systems across Energy, Enterprise, and Telecommunications. We also drive precision and efficiency in Industrials & Robotics and support life-critical innovation in Medical technologies.

Guided by our winning culture and values to Think & Act Like Owners, as One Team, and Play to Win, we turn commitment into results and achieve more together.

Join Us to Deliver Innovative Solutions That People Trust!

role: Innovation & Technology Internship - Software Engineering: Data & Intelligence Summer 2027 Graduate

jd:
Overview 

 Join Esri Summer Internship Program Video 

 Build Technology That Matters 

 As a Software Development Engineer Intern at Esri, you will work closely with experienced software developers and engineers to build innovative analytics software used across industries. You will contribute to ArcGIS products while gaining hands-on experience with coding, testing, troubleshooting, collaboration, and modern software development practices.

 Responsibilities 

 What You’ll Experience 

• Collaborate with members of the product development team to design, develop, and test software. 

• Assist with maintaining and improving existing software applications. 

• Write quality code, apply coding standards, use version control, participate in code reviews, and maintain code in a shared repository. 

• Identify and resolve issues in software code by analyzing and troubleshooting software defects. 

• Stay current on emerging technologies and trends in software development. 
 
 Real Projects Interns May Work On 

• Research and implement a large language model for testing or test automation. 

• Support DevOps work using Python, Jenkins, Ansible, GitHub, and Docker. 

• Explore machine learning-driven GIS for aerial detection or pattern discovery in large datasets. 

• Develop augmented reality, Android, JavaScript, web, mobile, 3D, or disaster-response applications connected to ArcGIS. 
 
 What You’ll Gain 

• Hands-on software engineering experience connected to ArcGIS and geospatial technology. 

• Exposure to code reviews, shared repositories, testing, troubleshooting, DevOps, automation, mobile, web, data science, or machine learning projects. 

• Mentorship, feedback, and a clearer view of software development career paths at Esri. 

• Connections with fellow interns and professionals across the company. 

 Requirements 

 We’re Excited to Meet Students Who 

• Are currently enrolled in a four-year undergraduate, graduate, or PhD program at a university in the United States, majoring in computer science, computer engineering, software engineering, or a related field. 

• For undergraduate students, are in junior or senior standing. 

• Have knowledge in one or more of these areas: C++, C#, Python, Java, JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML5, iOS, Android, or Windows mobile technology. GIS experience is not required. 

• Are curious, collaborative, and interested in learning through real software development work. 

• Can complete a consecutive, onsite 12-week internship beginning in May or June 2027. 

• Are able to obtain work authorization in the United States in 2027. 

 Program Timeline   

• Applications Accepted:  September 2–December 31, 2026 at 5:00 pm PST  

• Interviews:  Students selected for phone interviews will be notified by email on a rolling basis October 2026–January 31, 2027  

• Internship:  12 weeks beginning in late May or June 2027  

 Recommended Qualifications 
 Total Rewards 

 The pay range for this position takes into account education level and previous relevant work experience to include specialized skill sets. Students who meet minimum qualifications during their assignment may also qualify for 401(k) and profit share.

 A reasonable estimate of the base pay range is
 $38 — $46 USD
fit_why: Broad SWE intern; JS/TS and Python fit, but US-enrolled requirement and ArcGIS focus

jd:
Who we are 

 At CarGurus (NASDAQ: CARG), our mission is to give people the power to reach their destination. We started as a small team of developers determined to bring trust and transparency to car shopping. Since then, our history of innovation and go-to-market acceleration has driven industry-leading growth. In fact, we’re the largest and fastest-growing automotive marketplace, and we’ve been profitable for over 15 years.

 What we do 

 The market is evolving, and we are too, moving the entire automotive journey online and guiding our customers through every step. That includes everything from the sale of an old car to the financing, purchase, and delivery of a new one. Today, tens of millions of consumers visit CarGurus.com each month, and ~30,000 dealerships use our products. But they're not the only ones who love CarGurus—our employees do, too. We have a people-first culture that fosters kindness, collaboration, and innovation, and empowers our Gurus with tools to fuel their career growth. Disrupting a trillion-dollar industry requires fresh and diverse perspectives. Come join us for the ride!

 Role overview 
 CarGurus is looking for a Software Development Engineer Intern for the International Engineering team . 
 
 As a Software Development Engineer Intern , you will join an 11-week Summer Internship Program designed to give you hands-on experience, expand your professional network, and build core industry skills. This full-time opportunity (40 hours per week) runs from June through August 2027. CarGurus operates on a hybrid working model, and candidates should expect to work out of our Boston, MA office 60% of the time (approximately three days per week).

 What you'll do 

• Work with Java, MySQL, and front-end technologies (JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Remix) including microservices to build applications at CarGurus 

• Work on a multi-functional team focused on CarGurus International presence (Canada & UK) 

• Collaborate with data analysts, product managers, and other engineers 

• Participate in whiteboard sessions and design conversations on engineering the best solution to the challenges at hand 

• Test out new insights with novel and quick experiments 

• Write clean, well-tested, and efficient code 

• Collaborate with and enjoy mentorship by highly skilled engineers 

 What you'll bring 

• Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related field, with eligibility to complete a full-time internship. 

• You are familiar with and have a foundational understanding of Java, algorithms, and data structures, as well as front-end technologies (JavaScript/TypeScript, React, HTML, CSS) 

• You are eager to learn and expand your capabilities 

• You are drawn to and thrive in a fast-paced environment that pushes code daily 

• You are able to work independently, as well as in a team environment 

• Strong written and verbal communication skills 

• Bonus: Relational/non-relational database knowledge 
 
 The displayed range represents the expected hourly rate for this position.

 The displayed range represents the expected annual base salary / On-Target Earnings (OTE) for this position. On-Target Earnings (OTE) is inclusive of base salary and on-target commission earnings, which applies exclusively to sales roles.

Individual pay within this range is determined by work location and other factors such as job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

This annual base salary forms part of a comprehensive Total Rewards Package. In addition to benefits, this role may qualify for discretionary bonuses/incentives and Restricted Stock Units (RSUs). 

 Position Pay Range
 $35 — $35 USD 

Working at CarGurus 

 We reward our Gurus’ curiosity and passion with best-in-class benefits and compensation, including equity for all employees, both when they start and as they continue to grow with us. Our career development and corporate giving programs, as well as our employee resource groups (ERGs) and communities, help people build connections while making an impact in personally meaningful ways. A flexible hybrid model and robust time off policies encourage work-life balance and individual well-being. Thoughtful perks like daily free lunch, a new car discount, meditation and fitness apps, commuting cost coverage, and more help our people create space for what matters most in their personal and professional lives.

CarGurus may require in-person interviews as part of our hiring process, particularly for positions based in our Boston and Dublin offices. Candidates selected for an in-person interview will be notified in advance. Please be aware that travel expenses are the responsibility of the candidate.

 We welcome all 

 CarGurus strives to be a place to which people can bring the ultimate expression of themselves and their potential—starting with our hiring process. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, or sexual orientation. We foster an inclusive environment that values people for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. That’s why we hope you’ll apply even if you don’t check every box listed in the job description. We also encourage you to tell your recruiter if you require accommodations to participate in our hiring process due to a disability so we can provide the appropriate support. We want to know what only you can bring to CarGurus.
fit_why: Java/MySQL-centric enterprise intern; his core is TS/Python, Java only projects

role: Operations Management System Intern - Digital & AI Innovation
jd:
Job Type:
Intern/Student (Fixed Term) 
 Plains is an industry-leading transportation and midstream provider specializing in transportation, storage, processing and marketing solutions for crude oil. We own an extensive network of pipeline transportation, terminalling, storage and gathering assets in key oil producing basins and transportation corridors and at major market hubs in the United States and Canada. The company is headquartered in Houston, Texas.
  
 We’re on the lookout for passionate self‑starters who thrive in fast‑moving, collaborative, and innovative environments.
 
 New to the midstream energy sector? No problem! Plains offers a comprehensive formal training program, featuring on-the-job training, companywide learning series, online educational tools ( see sample ) and student programs. 
 
 About this student opportunity   
 
 At Plains, students are vital members of our team, driving our business forward with their fresh perspectives and innovative ideas. From day one, you’ll feel empowered to ask questions and truly be part of our collaborative culture.
 
 We offer students the chance to build professional networks by working alongside skilled professionals, mentors, and fellow students. Our student programs provide hands-on experience within the oil and gas midstream sector and opportunities for students to take on higher level projects depending on their skills and career interests.
 
 Plains’ Early Talent program is an opportunity for post-secondary students to get hands-on experience and education that aligns with their degree in the oil and gas midstream sector. Our intern opportunities have been specifically designed to provide students with the opportunity to apply their academic studies and gain valuable experience through meaningful and challenging work. Plains offers one of the industry’s best formal training programs where high achieving participants may become eligible to receive an offer to join Plains upon graduation.   
   
 Plains is currently seeking a student to join our Operations Strategy and Management System team as the Intern, Operations Management System, Digital & AI Innovation. The position is expected to begin May 17, 2027, with flexibility in both the start date and duration to accommodate the successful candidate’s availability and interest. This opportunity provides hands-on experience at the intersection of operational strategy, management systems, data analytics, digital solutions, automation, and AI within a complex industry.  
   
 Responsibilities   
 
• Develop, test, maintain, and continuously improve Power Platform solutions, including Power Apps, Power Automate, and Power BI that support the team’s processes and workflows.  
• Analyze data and communicate insights using Excel, Power BI, or other analytical and visualization tools.  
• Develop, test, and refine AI agents and other AI-enabled solutions to improve access to information, automate routine activities, and support business processes.  
• Explore opportunities to apply generative AI, machine learning, intelligent automation, and other emerging technologies within the team.  
• Support the responsible application of AI, including testing solutions for accuracy, reliability, usability, and intended use.  
• Identify, recommend, and help implement opportunities to digitize, streamline, and automate processes to improve efficiency and effectiveness.    
 Qualifications   
 
• Pursuing a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer and Data Science, Business, Engineering, Information Services, or a related field.  
• Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.  
• Experience with Microsoft SharePoint and Microsoft Power Platform, including Power Apps, Power Automate, and Power BI, is preferred.  
• Experience with AI productivity tools, generative AI, or AI agents, such as Microsoft Copilot is preferred.  
• Interest in learning how to design, develop, test, troubleshoot, and continuously improve digital and AI-enabled solutions in a business environment.  
• Curious, proactive, and eager to learn and experiment with new technologies.  
• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills.  
• Detailed-orientated with a focus on accuracy and quality.  
• Ability to translate business needs and process challenges into practical solutions.  
• Ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a team environment.  
• Must be able and willing to relocate Houston for the duration of the work term.  
• Must be able to commit to a 3-month work term starting May 17, 2027, to be considered for the program.  
• The successful candidate must comply with the Company’s Drug & Alcohol Policy including pre-employment testing.  
• The successful candidate must provide satisfactory references and complete a Criminal Background Check.  
• This position is not eligible for employment-based visa sponsorship. Applicants must be authorized to work in Canada or the U.S. for the duration of their employment.  #Plains

 How to ace your interview: 
 
• Application Essentials: Include your resume, cover letter, and transcript.
 
• Stay Updated: Check your email (including junk folder) frequently.
 
• Preparation Tips:
 
• Learn about the midstream industry (TIP: watch this video ).
 
• Understand our core values , recent Plains news , or read our sustainability report .
 
• Dress and communicate professionally.
 
• Inform us of any vacation plans or changes in availability.
 
• Prepare questions to ask at the end of your interview.
 
 As a student at Plains you'll receive competitive compensation, industry leading work experience, and the opportunity to take part in a variety of social events with colleagues. T he program focuses on delivering meaningful experiences that aligns with students’ education and career development goals. We value students’ contributions while supporting a healthy balance between work, school, and personal priorities.
  
 We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer . We are committed to providing employment opportunities to all qualified individuals, without regard to age, race, color, national or ethnic origin, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, genetic information, disability, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law. Applicants with disabilities can request accessible formats, communication supports, or other accessibility assistance by contacting WebCareers@Plains.com .
  
 Salary details estimated by job boards such as Indeed, Glassdoor, and LinkedIn do not represent Plains’ compensation structure. We thank all candidates for their interest; however, only those selected for an interview will be contacted. 
  
 By submitting your resume, you consent to the collection, use and necessary disclosure of the personal information provided during the application and selection process. Learn more .

 Role overview 

 CarGurus Finance is seeking a curious, analytical student to join us as a Finance AI Solutions Intern. You will help Finance teams identify repetitive, data-intensive work and pilot responsible AI and automation solutions that improve speed, accuracy, and insight.

 You will own a primary, high-impact project with a Finance partner while gaining exposure to Accounting, FP&A, Tax, Finance Operations, and Procurement. Along the way, you will learn how a public-company Finance organization evaluates new technology: not only whether it works, but whether it is accurate, reviewable, secure, and scalable.

 This is an opportunity to build a portfolio of practical work at the intersection of finance, data, process improvement, and AI, while receiving mentorship from Finance leaders.

 As a Finance AI Solutions Intern, you will join a 11-week Summer Internship Program designed to give you hands-on experience, expand your professional network, and build core industry skills. This full-time opportunity (40 hours per week) runs from June through August 2027. CarGurus operates on a hybrid working model, and candidates should expect to work out of our Boston, MA office 60% of the time (approximately three days per week).

 What you'll do 

• Partner with a Finance team to map a manual or data-intensive workflow and identify opportunities to improve it through AI, automation, or better analytics. 

• Build and test a scoped prototype using various LLMs and approved tools such as Excel or Google Sheets, SQL, or workflow-automation platforms. 

• Conduct research and analysis to support use cases such as reconciliations, exception review, variance analysis, vendor and spend analysis, contract or invoice data extraction, and finance-operations inquiries. 

• Validate outputs with process owners; document assumptions, review steps, limitations, and measurable impact. 

• Support Finance and Internal Controls stakeholders in documenting appropriate guardrails for selected AI-assisted workflows, including human review, evidence retention, and audit trails. 

• Work with partners across Finance and, as needed, teams such as Sales Operations, Collections, and Finance Systems to understand data flows and improve processes responsibly. 

• Present your project outcomes, recommendations, and measured business impact to Finance leadership at the end of the internship. 

 What you'll bring 

• You are currently pursuing a bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Analytics, Economics, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, and are eligible to complete a full-time summer internship. 

• You have strong analytical and problem-solving skills and enjoy understanding how processes work before improving them. 

• You are proficient in Excel or Google Sheets and comfortable working with structured data. 

• You are curious about AI and automation and interested in applying them responsibly in a business setting. 

• You communicate clearly in writing and in conversation, and can explain an analysis or recommendation to both technical and business audiences. 

• You are organized, detail-oriented, self-directed, and comfortable working through ambiguity with guidance from experienced teammates. 

• You have an interest in finance, accounting, operations, or how businesses use data to make decisions. 

 Helpful, but not required 

• Coursework, academic projects, campus employment, or prior internship experience involving data analysis, prompt design, or workflow automation. 

• Experience using AI tools to research, analyze data, draft content, or streamline a recurring task. 

• Familiarity with CRM, ERP, billing, BI, or financial systems such as Salesforce, NetSuite, Zuora, Looker, or similar platforms. 

• Exposure to internal controls, audit, risk, or compliance concepts.

Who we are 

 At CarGurus (NASDAQ: CARG), our mission is to give people the power to reach their destination. We started as a small team of developers determined to bring trust and transparency to car shopping. Since then, our history of innovation and go-to-market acceleration has driven industry-leading growth. In fact, we’re the largest and fastest-growing automotive marketplace, and we’ve been profitable for over 15 years.

 What we do 

 The market is evolving, and we are too, moving the entire automotive journey online and guiding our customers through every step. That includes everything from the sale of an old car to the financing, purchase, and delivery of a new one. Today, tens of millions of consumers visit CarGurus.com each month, and ~30,000 dealerships use our products. But they're not the only ones who love CarGurus—our employees do, too. We have a people-first culture that fosters kindness, collaboration, and innovation, and empowers our Gurus with tools to fuel their career growth. Disrupting a trillion-dollar industry requires fresh and diverse perspectives. Come join us for the ride!

 Role overview 

 CarGurus is looking for a highly motivated Data Platform Engineer Intern for the Data Engineering team to support evolving our modern data warehousing platform to world-class levels! As CarGurus enters the next phase of dramatic growth with new data sources, new business lines, and business acquisitions, we are looking for a candidate who is interested in learning and being part of revamping how we do data at the company.

 As a Data Platform Engineer Intern, you will join an 11-week Summer Internship Program designed to give you hands-on experience, expand your professional network, and build core industry skills. This full-time opportunity (40 hours per week) runs from June through August 2027. CarGurus operates on a hybrid working model, and candidates should expect to work out of our Boston, MA office 60% of the time (approximately three days per week).

 What you'll do 

• Gain a deep understanding of our evolving data and analytics stack 

• Understand and follow the decisions around the Data Engineering domain while providing input into strategic decisions around the overall data pipeline process 

• Help build robust and scalable data integration (ETL/ELT) pipelines using Fivetran, Python, SQL and Airflow 

• Write clean data pipeline code that is easily testable, understood by other developers, and handles errors 

• Partner with stakeholders / leads to develop testing 

• Collaborate with upstream data producers and downstream data consumers, and maintain a healthy work environment 

• Deploy and manage our data infrastructure using Terraform 

 What you'll bring 

• Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Management, or a related field, with eligibility to complete a full-time internship. 

• Exposure to data engineering and interest in designing and building scalable and reliable data pipelines and infrastructure 

• Proficiency with Python programming skills and knowledge of SQL 

• Experience working in a cross-functional team environment 

• Good understanding of overall data pipeline system architecture and data modeling 

• Good problem-solving skills and attention to detail 

• Working knowledge of workflow management tools like Airflow, Luigi etc 

• Understanding of requirement gathering, analysis, code review, unit and integration testing 

• Great teammate, interested in sharing knowledge with other team members, and is curious about learning new technologies 
 
 The displayed range represents the expected hourly rate for this position.

 The displayed range represents the expected annual base salary / On-Target Earnings (OTE) for this position. On-Target Earnings (OTE) is inclusive of base salary and on-target commission earnings, which applies exclusively to sales roles.

Individual pay within this range is determined by work location and other factors such as job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

This annual base salary forms part of a comprehensive Total Rewards Package. In addition to benefits, this role may qualify for discretionary bonuses/incentives and Restricted Stock Units (RSUs). 

 Position Pay Range
 $30 — $30 USD 

Working at CarGurus 

 We reward our Gurus’ curiosity and passion with best-in-class benefits and compensation, including equity for all employees, both when they start and as they continue to grow with us. Our career development and corporate giving programs, as well as our employee resource groups (ERGs) and communities, help people build connections while making an impact in personally meaningful ways. A flexible hybrid model and robust time off policies encourage work-life balance and individual well-being. Thoughtful perks like daily free lunch, a new car discount, meditation and fitness apps, commuting cost coverage, and more help our people create space for what matters most in their personal and professional lives.

CarGurus may require in-person interviews as part of our hiring process, particularly for positions based in our Boston and Dublin offices. Candidates selected for an in-person interview will be notified in advance. Please be aware that travel expenses are the responsibility of the candidate.

 We welcome all 

 CarGurus strives to be a place to which people can bring the ultimate expression of themselves and their potential—starting with our hiring process. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, or sexual orientation. We foster an inclusive environment that values people for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. That’s why we hope you’ll apply even if you don’t check every box listed in the job description. We also encourage you to tell your recruiter if you require accommodations to participate in our hiring process due to a disability so we can provide the appropriate support. We want to know what only you can bring to CarGurus.
